name: unlimited-persistent-memory
what_it_does: Maintains persistent context, user history, and operational rules across months by reading/writing to an Obsidian markdown vault

name: bidirectional-voice-chat
what_it_does: Enables low-latency spoken conversations with a personalized AI voice via hotkey/push-to-talk without typing

name: tri-state-visualizer-hud
what_it_does: Displays real-time full-screen circuit board graphics with active states for listening (waveform), thinking (scramble), and speaking

name: local-file-read-and-rewrite
what_it_does: Reads local project files, writes code, and rewrites broken scripts directly on the host machine

name: terminal-command-execution
what_it_does: Executes real shell commands on the underlying host operating system to build, test, and repair software

name: live-web-search
what_it_does: Performs real-time web searches to gather external documentation and verify information when local knowledge is insufficient

name: parallel-subagent-dispatch
what_it_does: Spins up parallel sub-agent instances to pursue multiple research or coding tasks concurrently while maintaining primary user dialogue

name: optical-gesture-window-manipulation
what_it_does: Tracks bare hand gestures via standard webcam to grab, move, zoom, and rotate floating UI windows without hardware controllers

name: 3d-model-ar-rendering
what_it_does: Loads and renders interactive 3D GLB assets in spatial screen space manipulable via wrist rotation and pinch scaling

name: claw-remote-grab
what_it_does: Identifies target screen elements via hand pointing and locks them to cursor upon fist clench for distance grabbing

name: voice-triggered-image-projection
what_it_does: Retrieves local images via natural language voice request and instantiates them as floating resizable AR window panels
